HAKUNA MATATA

A 2D action platformer where you fight your way past zombies and traps to reach the end of the level.

What to Do?

Defeat zombies using your pistol or a close-range melee attack.
Watch out for Reflectors—if you shoot them, your bullet bounces straight back at you.
Stay alive and make it to the end of the map.

Controls

Move Left / Right: A / D or Left / Right Arrow
Jump: Space
Crouch: S or Down Arrow
Aim Up: W or Up Arrow
Shoot: Left Click
Melee Attack: Right Click

How the Game Ends

Find the Statue at the end of the level, walk up to it, and crouch in front of it to win the game.

You have no gun. The turrets do all the shooting, and your only weapon is their own fire. Catch the slow, glowing orbs they send at you, then throw them back, ideally bouncing them off a wall for extra damage.

Catch and throw: Time your catch for full power. Hold up to 3 orbs for a bigger blast, but catch a 4th and you overload.
Think in colors: Red, blue and green turrets are immune to their own color, so use one color’s fire to destroy another.
Bank your shots: Wall bounces and quick counter-hits add bonus damage.
3 levels, 5 difficulties: From Easy to Nightmare, with patrol turrets in the final level.

 Fire Laser: (Add your fire key here, e.g., Spacebar / Right-Click) and shoot the beam.

 R: Restart the level and reset your mirrors at any time.
